question: Why did the p95 latency go up on 19 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of checkout v2.26 caused increased latency and connection pool exhaustion.
why_chain: Checkout v2.26 deployment led to a change in service checkout's performance.
The change in checkout v2.26 deployment caused the p95 latency to rise.
The increased latency and connection pool exhaustion are symptoms of the deployment change.

contributing_factors.description: Config change to reduce db.pool_size from 50 to 5 led to increased latency and connection pool exhaustion.
why_chain: Reducing db.pool_size from 50 to 5 caused a change in service checkout's performance.
The reduced db.pool_size deployment change caused the p95 latency to rise.
The increased latency and connection pool exhaustion are symptoms of the config change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Increased request volume caused the p95 latency to rise.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume remained about the same before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Error rate increase was due to external factors.
ruled_out.reason: Error rate increase is a symptom, not a cause.

ruled_out.hypothesis: Connection pool exhaustion was due to external factors.
ruled_out.reason: Connection pool exhaustion is a symptom, not a cause.

evidence.summary: P95 latency for service checkout rose from 220 ms to 601 ms (+173%), with a change point at 2026-03-19T15:15:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout: 3 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.02).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout stayed about the same (852 per 5 min before, 958 per 5 min after, +12%).
At the same time, error rate for service checkout rose (0.43% before, 0.67% after, +55%).
Deployed checkout v2.26 to us-east (checkout, us-east; 2 min before the change; record R017; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
Changed checkout db.pool_size from 50 to 5 (all regions) (checkout; 1 min before the change; record R018; fit: right time and place: a strong candidate cause)
p95 latency above SLO on checkout (checkout; 15 min after the change; record R020; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R019; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)
checkout: WARN connection pool exhausted, waiting for a free connection (checkout, us-east; 27 min after the change; record R021; fit: after the change, so a symptom, not a cause)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 3 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✗ 1 other change event(s) fit about as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
✗ Two or more changes fit equally well, so the cause cannot be confirmed.
missing_data: Details to tell the competing changes apart (e.g. a rollback test)

actions.action: Rollback the deployment of checkout v2.26
Rollback the config change to reduce db.pool_size
Monitor and optimize the connection pool size for checkout
